answers.assumption_check: Load-bearing: the carry code works (every cast after 16:07 produced its berth file) and the missing piece is only that the file is not staged with the ticket. Not assumed: that refusing a commit is the right enforcement; a softer alternative (a sieve in build_inspector that reds an untracked berth) would not stop the push. A pre-commit refusal is Law 4's physics, but it touches every ticket commit, so the build must prove it passes a commit that has its berths and names the fix when it does not.
answers.builder_check: A Haiku builder cannot build this yet: the pre-commit extension has a design choice (refuse vs warn, and how a worktree commons is found) the build's first decision settles. The ticket states D1-D3 and the measured facts.

answers.collision_check: Looked at ticket d692ef650534 (the carry, which this completes), the existing pre-commit rule that refuses staged record bytes the journal never saw (this extends it to berths), and 30531f6e1c5d (the artifact door's journal). No overlap; _carry_berths is out of bounds.
answers.falsifier_check: Clauses: (1) a ticket-state commit without its berth is refused naming it; with the berth staged it passes | (2) the jurisdiction declares the berths as records. Horizon: red on current main (nothing refuses, no berths record set), green after; proven over a scratch commons with a fake ticket and berth.
